description: This file defines a Java interface named FileRemove which declares methods for removing files associated with a merchant store in a CMS module.

classes.name: FileRemove
classes.description: An interface declaring methods to remove files or groups of files in a CMS content management context.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file identified by filename for a given merchant store and content type.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all files associated with a given merchant store.
